definitions.gloss: to clear up, to become sunny
definitions.explanation: Describes weather becoming clear or sunny, with clouds disappearing. Used for sky and weather conditions.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}は{晴|は}れるでしょう。
examples.english: It will probably clear up tomorrow.
It will clear up from the afternoon.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xが{晴|は}れる (X clears up).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {晴|は}れている = 'is clear/sunny' (current weather state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{空|そら}が{晴|は}れる (sky clears)
・{明日|あした}{晴|は}れる (will clear up tomorrow)
・{晴|は}れた{日|ひ} (sunny day)
・{晴|は}れ{時|とき}々{曇|くも}り (partly cloudy)

Noun: {晴|は}れ (clear weather). Opposite: {曇|くも}る (become cloudy). Weather words: {晴|は}れ, {曇|くも}り, {雨|あめ}.
